callsUsed.title: Entrata & Villa Maria Manor: Affordable Discussion
callsUsed.brief: Matthew and Jun from Entrata, along with Iris from Villa Maria Manor, discussed Entrata's capabilities for affordable housing, particularly in light of Villa Maria Manor's unique HUD contract and upcoming software needs. Iris is exploring new software options to improve resident engagement, maintenance, and overall system integration, and is interested in Entrata's potential to provide a comprehensive, unified platform. They agreed to schedule a series of demos focusing on marketing/leasing, affordable housing functionality, and financial integration with Sage Intact.

callsUsed.brief: Jon, Jun, Tijah, and Matthew from Entrata discussed travel destinations like Las Vegas, Miami, and New Orleans, as well as potential relocation spots in Texas, Tennessee, North Carolina, and Alabama. The call also touched on family life, particularly Jun's recent experience with twins, and concluded with a discussion about attendance at the upcoming NAA conference in New Orleans and the absence of Iris from the scheduled demo.

callsUsed.title: Entrata & Villa Maria Manor: Demo
callsUsed.brief: Jon, Matthew, Tijah and Jun from Entrata, along with Iris from Villa Maria Manor, discussed Entrata's capabilities as a potential integrated solution for Villa Maria Manor's conventional and affordable properties, focusing on resident communication, maintenance, and system consolidation. Iris expressed interest in Entrata's user-friendly design, automation features, and comprehensive lead management, particularly for waitlist management and HUD compliance. A follow-up call was scheduled to delve deeper into affordable-specific functionalities.

callsUsed.title: Entrata & Villa Maria Manor: Affordable Demo
callsUsed.brief: Tijah, Jun and Matthew from Entrata, along with Iris from Villa Maria Manor, discussed Entrata's affordable housing functionality, including property setup, lead-to-lease workflow, recertifications, reporting, and AI-powered tools, with a focus on Section 8 compliance and integration with existing processes. Iris expressed interest in Entrata's maintenance section, inspection capabilities, and the ability to track resident income history, and a follow-up demo was scheduled to address these specific needs and pricing. Iris will make a decision on technology adoption before or in early July.

callsUsed.title: Entrata & Villa Maria Manor: Follow-up Demo
callsUsed.brief: Tijah and Jun from Entrata, along with Iris from Villa Maria Manor, discussed Entrata's maintenance and communication features, focusing on inspection processes, AI capabilities, and resident communication tools, particularly for a large blind resident population. Iris expressed interest in Entrata's offerings, especially the maintenance system and AI features, but raised concerns about accessibility and implementation timing due to upcoming organizational changes and HUD-related deadlines. The next step is a pricing proposal and further discussion in late June to determine the best implementation plan.
